serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Ah…
Finally I have a moment for myself…
After that whole fish joint deal I didn’t have time to process it at all.
I was too freaked out to even register all those memories rushing into my head.
If it was supposed to bring me closure or help me fight my fears or whatever, it did a shitty job.
Now I’m only more aware of my faults and weaknesses, but maybe that was the entire point.
It didn’t help me solve these issues but made me aware of their existence.
I should probably do something about it, but how do I even start? If I knew that getting better at fishing would have such a heavy price I would refuse that joint immediately.
Maybe in the long run it’s better for me, but being forced to address all of these problems at the same time is just too much for me right now…
I need to put it on hold and forget about it. Perhaps if I tell myself that those visions were a product of my imagination and had no meaning enough times, I'll start to believe it?
But in the end it would make that whole thing just about useless…
I will give myself some more time to process, to heal. I will do something about it after that.
I know it’s all just my wishful thinking. The most probable way this all ends is with me burying it again and keeping it hidden until reality kicks me in the balls and forces all those dirty secrets out of my throat.
What can I say? These apparitions were right. I’m weak. I’m unable to face the truth.
It was one thing to battle them in my mind where there are no consequences, but out here… {{wi}}I’m too scared to lift a finger…
But I need to find this strength. I need to get a grip, or I might really lose it all.
Step by step. Very small steps. One issue at a time. That’s the way to do it. I just hope it won’t be too late when I finish…
